findings.excerpt: Gregg Williams posted the best round of the day at Royal Óbidos in the TEG 8 Trophy.
He opened with back-to-back bogeys, then a par at the 3rd.
Williams read it as a dare and took a quadruple bogey.
a stretch from the 7th to the 10th that gained six shots against par
Then the 14th, and a quintuple bogey, and the hole in the floor reopened beneath him.
Despite it, the back nine finished ten shots stronger than the front.
Nobody in the six-man field did better all day.

findings.excerpt: Alex Baker widened his own gap to 7
Baker's is at the bottom.
Jon Baker arrived at Royal Óbidos in R3 off a second round of -7 net.
At the par-5 2nd, stroke index 3 and one of the hardest holes on the course, he made a quintuple bogey 10.
He answered immediately at the par-3 3rd with a quadruple bogey 7.
He did rally in a manner of speaking, going the 7th and 8th without dropping a gross shot.
Baker swung from -7 in Round 2 to +5 net in Round 3, a 12-shot reversal.

findings.excerpt: Henry Meller kept the overall lead and watched his advantage grow from 11 to 15 without lifting a finger.
Henry Meller turned for home at Royal Óbidos level with David Mullin at the top of the TEG 16 Green Jacket.
He had drawn level at the 14th with a par on the sixth-hardest hole.

He signed off with a double bogey at the par-5 18th, presumably for symmetry.
Ten shots in four holes, and the Jacket lead went back to Mullin.
Meller shot 15-under net par in Round 2 and managed -1 in Round 3, a 14-shot swing.
